Independent review present:
Minimum participation and review requirements met:

## Auditable ballots
Account, qualification link, ballot comment link, timestamp, choice, proposal version, and disclosed interests for each counted ballot. Record superseded or excluded ballots and reasons separately. Record disputes; do not expose private data.

## Decision and reasoning
Adopted, not adopted, or no decision under the published rules. Show how the tally and participation requirements determine the outcome. Preserve evidence, strongest dissent, unresolved risks, and any outcome-changing procedural dispute. Identify the recorder, not an individual policy approver. No founder override applies.

## Integration
Approved wording or commit:
Pull request:
Affected documents:
Contributor permission or license:
Final verification of fidelity to the voted text:
Merge commit and verification:
Status (accepted awaiting integration, integrated, deferred, rejected):

## Revisit
Review trigger, remaining questions, and reconsideration route. Every decision can be revised by a later valid vote, including through a reasoned change of judgment.
